classification.ordinaryAirToAir: launch-authority ramp, then PN; no trajectory phase
classification.qaam: same launch as ordinary AAM; reattack is a seeker phase, not a launch phase
classification.vlsShipSam: vertical eject, bounded capture, blended PN
classification.directGroundSamAndMissileBoat: target-bearing ejection, then PN; no VLS capture
classification.lasm: safe separation, sea-skimming cruise, terminal latch
classification.agm4: safe separation, terrain-aware loft, terminal dive
classification.bomb: ballistic release; excluded from guided launch-phase state
